identificationModule.briefTitle: NALIRIFOX Combined With PD-1 Sequential Radiotherapy Versus NALIRIFOX as Conversion Therapy of Locally Advanced Pancreatic Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Prospective, Open, Randomized Controlled, Multicenter, Exploratory Clinical Study of NALIRIFOX Combined With PD-1 Sequential Radiotherapy Versus NALIRIFOX for Conversion Therapy for Locally Advanced Pancreatic Cancer

leadSponsor.name: The Affiliated Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital of Nanjing University Medical School

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of the prospective, open, randomized controlled, multicenter, exploratory clinical study is to evaluate efficacy and safety of NALIRIFOX Combined With PD-1 Sequential Radiotherapy Versus NALIRIFOX for Conversion Therapy for Locally Advanced Pancreatic Cancer

armGroups.label: NALIRINOX combined with PD-1 synchronous sequential SBRT group
armGroups.description: Nal-IRI+Oxaliplatin+5- FU +PD-1, these drugs are given on d1, d15, 28 days as one cycle, SBRT is performed during the third and fourth cycle.

armGroups.label: NALIRIFOX group
armGroups.description: Nal-IRI+Oxaliplatin+5- FU, these drugs are given on d1, d15, 28 days as one cycle.

interventions.description: Nal-lRl+Oxaliplatin+5- FU +PD-1, these drugs are given on d1, d15, 28 days as one cycle, SBRT is performed during the third and fourth cycle.

primaryOutcomes.description: Proportion of patients alive from randomization to 1 year

secondaryOutcomes.description: Percentage of patients who achieved R0/RI resection
Proportion of patients who achieved mPR by post-operative specimen testing
According to RECIST version 1.1, the proportion of patients who achieved remission (PR+CR) after treatment and maintained the minimum time-frame requirement.
Time from randomization to disease progression and/or death.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: The incidence of grade 3 or higher AE and serious adverse event(SAE) [Safety]
secondaryOutcomes.description: Using the Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (NCI-CTCAE) version 5.0, we analyzed the data of all subjects who received at least one study treatment. We collected and summarized the overall incidence of adverse events (AE), the incidence of grade 3 or higher AE, and the incidence of serious adverse events (SAE).
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From the first treatment to 28 days after the last treatment, about 6 months
